profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Fixed a critical memory leak issue in one of the Tier 1 service that empowers all search. The error rate decreased from roughly 1.05% to less than 0.1%, equivalent to 99.05% improvement. And p99 latency has gone down from an average of 757ms to 418 ms, about 44.8% improvement
- Improved Omnisuggest service which empowers nearly all search suggestions throughout compass platform. Reduced p95 latency from 1.46 seconds to 437 ms, roughly a 70% improvement.
- Designed, led and conducted research on the next generation Search API to allow clients to
dynamically build search query using Apache Thrift and presented a proof-of-concept project to stakeholders within Compass teams including Consumer Search, Agent Search and Mobile team
- Participated in mobile first cross functional team to design and implement Search History service allowing mobile users to modify search filters in MLS panels
- Improved existing search query database migration to avoid writing boilerplate migration templates, saving approximately 10 hours of engineers’ time weekly

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented highly scalable Video Catalog API integrating internal partners such as Hulu, Star+, ESPN+ and NatGeo
- Created a scaffold project utilizing Spring Boot, Dynamodb, and Kinesis to bring standardization, consistent API definitions and event messaging within the engineering group
- Migrating legacy services into an event-driven micro services utilizing the scaffold project

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for designing and developing the next generation content management for E! Online
Played a key role architecting migration of existing monolith application to microservices. Involved in building 8 different microservices from the ground up using Spring Boot and Spring Data as well as aggregator service using GraphQL and Apollo Server
- Self-taught Node.js and Serverless framework within 2 weeks and developed services including RSS Feed Generator which integrated with Google News Producer and MSN News

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and implemented key new features in Ericsson’s Content Management System including content search using ElasticSearch, workflow management using jBPM and Hazelcast
- Played a key role in identifying and fixing complex performance issues for high profile clients which assisted in extending their contracts
- Developed a fully automated patching tool using Python and Django which started off as a hackathon project working with a coworker that I drove to completion and launched as part of the product improving patch deployment cycle
